title: Verify search field decoding against a real Bleve index, not just hand-built responses
answers: How to test that requested search fields are actually indexed and decodable
How to build a test Bleve index for IAM user search fields
body:
Pattern: build a real bleve backend via unifiedsearch.NewBleveBackend with resource.NewSearchFieldsRegistry(nil, nil, providers) from iamapis.LocalManifest(), index a document with values for every requested field, then run index.Search with both ResourceSearchRequest_FIELD_VALUES and ResourceSearchRequest_RESOURCE_TABLE and assert ParseResults produces identical hit values for both formats.
Constraints: use this when adding/renaming a searchable field or changing ResultFormat, to catch cases where a field is requested but never actually indexed/decodable (a hand-mocked ResourceSearchResponse in unit tests won't catch that).
applies: pkg/registry/apis/iam/user/search_test.go and similar unified-storage search consumers
